highlights.reason_zh: DeepSeek 首次公开生产推理内核与确定性路径，但完整 serving 层仍缺，适合先审查再排期复现。
highlights.reason_en: DeepSeek exposes production inference internals and determinism paths, while the complete serving layer is still missing and should be reviewed before reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: 区域化语音 API 与明确价格可直接改变 voice agent 的供应商试验选择。
highlights.reason_en: Regional voice APIs and explicit pricing can directly change vendor trials for voice agents.

highlights.reason_zh: 人工专属审批和危险删除修复直接收紧无人值守 coding agent 的后果边界。
highlights.reason_en: Person-only approval and destructive-deletion fixes directly tighten consequence boundaries for unattended coding agents.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开代码让可学习 agent 记忆能够一天内复现，但小样本作者评测和污染风险必须一起看。
highlights.reason_en: Public code makes learned agent memory reproducible in a day, while the small author-run evaluation and poisoning risk must be assessed together.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开测试补上 COBOL、Fortran 等语言的可比基线，但不能把 benchmark 通过率当作迁移成功率。
highlights.reason_en: Public tests add comparable baselines for languages such as COBOL and Fortran, without turning benchmark pass rate into migration success.

coverage_zh: 36/36 个固定入口抓取并读完；主动检索覆盖小团队、开放权重、中文与非英语材料、RAG、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。性能数字均按发布方自报处理。DeepInfer 由召回自检补入；Mercury 3 已入库但未挤入五条重点。三个只有日期精度且无法确认小时边界的 10 月 20 日条目暂缓。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed; active discovery covered small teams, open weights, Chinese and other non-English material, RAG, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Performance figures are treated as publisher-reported. Recall audit recovered DeepInfer; Mercury 3 is cataloged but did not displace the five highlights. Three October 20 items with date-only evidence and unresolved hourly boundaries were deferred.
